decisions.P2-1: Fix in CW-06 (UI-local, no backend/contract change). (a) Decouple socket intake from VT feeding: drain the socket promptly into per-pane pending buffers; feed pyte in bounded slices (about 64 KiB or 20 ms per loop) and service stdin between slices so key latency stays bounded (< ~100 ms under flood). (b) UI catch-up: when a pane's unfed backlog exceeds a bound (e.g. 256 KiB, same order as backend replay tail), drop the older backlog, reset that pane's screen, feed only the most recent tail, show a visible per-pane indicator (e.g. '출력 따라잡음: N bytes 건너뜀'), and send the existing per-pane resize nudge so full-screen apps (OMP) redraw. Display is a view; backend state/retained tail are unchanged, so this is not a product behaviour change. (c) Send failures (EPIPE/ECONNRESET/timeout) = connection loss: drain received frames, show CLOSING reason (e.g. slow_client) and exit with a user-facing message, never a traceback. No backend backpressure change now; if flood still causes slow_client after (a)+(b), record as known limitation for UR-UX/CW-19.
